26 U.S.C. 223(b)(3) (HSA catch-up $1,000 at 55, not indexed); 26 U.S.C. 404(h)(1)(C) and 402(h)(2) (SEP 25% of compensation; 20% of net self-employment earnings for a sole proprietor)

IRS Publication 560 (2025): a sole proprietor with no employees can adopt a section 401(k) plan after the end of the tax year (2023 and later) by the filing deadline without extensions, its elective deferrals paid in by then; SEP set up and funded by the due date including extensions; qualified plan contributions by the due date plus extensions; Deduction Worksheet for Self-Employed and Rate Table for Self-Employed (a 25% plan rate is 0.20), https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p560.pdf
